msg.sender becomes the sender of the ERC20 transfer call.
msg.sender becomes the owner in the approve call.
msg.sender is used as spender when decrementing allowance in transferFrom.

onlyOwner gate on manualSend depends on msg.sender.

block.timestamp is passed as the swap deadline, making the swap outcome miner-timestamp dependent.

normalization_plan.reason: Sender parameter only exists to feed the _transfer state updates and requires no separate node.
Recipient parameter is a transient argument of _transfer used for zero-address and max-amount checks.
Amount parameter is a transient argument validated against _maxTxAmount.
Local snapshot drives the automatic swap decision inside _transfer.
Local ETH balance snapshot is passed directly into sendETHToTeam.
Token amount is a transient argument of the swap helper.
Local swap path array is only meaningful within the swap helper.
Amount parameter is transient input to the ETH distribution helper.
Fee flag only branches the transfer dispatch and fee toggling.
Token amount parameter is transient input to the transfer dispatch.
Account parameter is a transient read key for the balance view.
Fee parameter is validated then written to state within the setter.
Fee parameter is validated then written to state within the setter.
Limit parameter is validated then written to state within the setter.
New owner parameter is validated then written to the owner state.
Boolean parameter is written directly to the swapEnabled flag.
Loop index is purely a control detail of the excluded-array scan.
